mapping.get(lang_code)\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Core computation functions \u2500\u2500\u2500\n\ndef compute_dependency_distances(tokens: list[str], heads: list[int], deprels: list[str]) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"Compute word-space dependency distances for a sentence.\"\"\"\n    arcs = []\n    n = len(tokens)\n    for i in range(n):\n        h = heads[i]\n        if h == 0 or h == i + 1:  # root or self-loop\n            continue\n        dist = abs(h - (i + 1))\n        deprel = deprels[i] if i < len(deprels) else \"unknown\"\n        category = \"functional\" if deprel in FUNCTIONAL_DEPRELS else \"lexical\"\n        arcs.append({\n            \"head_id\": h,\n            \"dep_id\": i + 1,\n            \"deprel\": deprel,\n            \"category\": category,\n            \"word_dist\": dist,\n        })\n    return arcs\n\n\ndef compute_phoneme_distances(tokens: list[str], heads: list[int], deprels: list[str],\n                               epitran_code: Optional[str] = None) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"Compute phoneme-space dependency distances for a sentence.\"\"\"\n    e = None\n    if epitran_code:\n        try:\n            from epitran import Epitran\n            e = Epitran(epitran_code)\n        except Exception:\n            e = None\n\n    # Build phoneme-position index using char count as fallback for unknown scripts\n    phoneme_positions = []\n    running_idx = 0\n\n    for word in tokens:\n        if e and word.strip():\n            try:\n                phonemes = e.transliterate(word)\n                n_ph = len(phonemes.split())\n            except Exception:\n                n_ph = len(word)\n        else:\n            n_ph = max(len(word), 1)\n        phoneme_positions.append((running_idx, running_idx + n_ph))\n        running_idx += n_ph\n\n    arcs = []\n    n = len(tokens)\n    for i in range(n):\n        h = heads[i]\n        if h == 0 or h == i + 1:\n            continue\n\n        head_start, head_end = phoneme_positions[i]\n        dep_start, dep_end = phoneme_positions[h - 1]\n\n        if i + 1 < h:\n            phoneme_dist = dep_start - head_end\n        else:\n            phoneme_dist = head_start - dep_end\n        phoneme_dist = max(phoneme_dist, 0)\n\n        deprel = deprels[i] if i < len(deprels) else \"unknown\"\n        category = \"functional\" if deprel in FUNCTIONAL_DEPRELS else \"lexical\"\n\n        arcs.append({\n            \"head_id\": h,\n            \"dep_id\": i + 1,\n            \"deprel\": deprel,\n            \"category\": category,\n            \"word_dist\": abs(h - (i + 1)),\n            \"phoneme_dist\": phoneme_dist,\n        })\n    return arcs\n\n\ndef process_treebank(config_name: str, max_sentences: int = 0) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Process a single treebank config and return statistics.\"\"\"\n    import signal\n    \n    lang_code = config_name.split(\"_\")[0]\n    logger.info(f\"Processing {config_name} (lang={lang_code})\")\n\n    # Load dataset with timeout\n    try:\n        def _timeout_handler(signum, frame):\n            raise TimeoutError(f\"Loading {config_name} timed out\")\n        \n        old_handler = signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, _timeout_handler)\n        signal.alarm(60)  # 60 second timeout for loading\n        try:\n            ds = load_dataset(\"commul/universal_dependencies\", name=config_name, split=\"train\")\n        finally:\n            signal.alarm(0)\n            signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, old_handler)\n    except TimeoutError as e:\n        logger.warning(f\"Timed out loading {config_name}, skipping\")\n        return {\"config\": config_name, \"error\": \"timeout loading\", \"timeout\": True}\n    except Exception as e:\n        logger.warning(f\"Failed to load {config_name}: {e}\")\n        return {\"config\": config_name, \"error\": str(e)}\n\n    if len(ds) == 0:\n        return {\"config\": config_name, \"error\": \"empty dataset\"}\n\n    if max_sentences > 0:\n        ds = ds.select(range(min(max_sentences, len(ds))))\n\n    # Get epitran code\n    epitran_code = _get_epitran_code(lang_code)\n\n    all_word_arcs = []\n    all_phoneme_arcs = []\n    n_sentences = 0\n    n_failed = 0\n\n    for idx, row in enumerate(ds):\n        tokens = row[\"tokens\"]\n        heads = row[\"head\"]\n        deprels = row[\"deprel\"]\n\n        if not tokens or not heads:\n            continue\n\n        # Word-space distances\n        try:\n            w_arcs = compute_dependency_distances(tokens, heads, deprels)\n            all_word_arcs.extend(w_arcs)\n        except Exception as e:\n            n_failed += 1\n            continue\n\n        # Phoneme-space distances\n        try:\n            p_arcs = compute_phoneme_distances(tokens, heads, deprels, epitran_code)\n            all_phoneme_arcs.extend(p_arcs)\n        except Exception as e:\n            n_failed += 1\n            continue\n\n        n_sentences += 1\n        if (idx + 1) % 500 == 0:\n            logger.debug(f\"  Processed {idx+1}/{len(ds)} sentences\")\n\n    if not all_word_arcs:\n        return {\"config\": config_name, \"error\": \"no arcs computed\"}\n\n    # Compute statistics\n    word_dists = [a[\"word_dist\"] for a in all_word_arcs]\n    phoneme_dists = [a[\"phoneme_dist\"] for a in all_phoneme_arcs] if all_phoneme_arcs else []\n\n    # Split by category\n    func_word = [a[\"word_dist\"] for a in all_word_arcs if a[\"category\"] == \"functional\"]\n    lex_word = [a[\"word_dist\"] for a in all_word_arcs if a[\"category\"] == \"lexical\"]\n    func_phon = [a[\"phoneme_dist\"] for a in all_phoneme_arcs if a[\"category\"] == \"functional\"] if all_phoneme_arcs else []\n    lex_phon = [a[\"phoneme_dist\"] for a in all_phoneme_arcs if a[\"category\"] == \"lexical\"] if all_phoneme_arcs else []\n\n    # Distributional measures\n    def _dist_stats(dists: list[float]) -> dict:\n        if not dists:\n            return {\"mean\": 0, \"median\": 0, \"std\": 0, \"entropy\": 0, \"p_gt_2\": 0, \"p_gt_5\": 0}\n        arr = np.array(dists)\n        hist, _ = np.histogram(arr, bins=range(1, 21))\n        hist = hist / hist.sum()\n        entropy = -np.sum(hist[hist > 0] * np.log2(hist[hist > 0]))\n        return {\n            \"mean\": float(np.mean(arr)),\n            \"median\": float(np.median(arr)),\n            \"std\": float(np.std(arr)),\n            \"entropy\": float(entropy),\n            \"p_gt_2\": float(np.mean(arr > 2)),\n            \"p_gt_5\": float(np.mean(arr > 5)),\n        }\n\n    # Phonological info\n    phono = get_phono_info(lang_code)\n\n    result = {\n        \"config\": config_name,\n        \"lang_code\": lang_code,\n        \"language_family\": phono[\"family\"],\n        \"branch\": phono[\"branch\"],\n        \"word_order\": phono[\"word_order\"],\n        \"phoneme_count\": phono[\"phoneme_count\"],\n        \"n_sentences\": n_sentences,\n        \"n_arcs\": len(all_word_arcs),\n        \"n_failed\": n_failed,\n        \"epitran_code\": epitran_code,\n        \"has_phoneme_data\": len(phoneme_dists) > 0,\n        \"mdd_word\": _dist_stats(word_dists),\n        \"mdd_phoneme\": _dist_stats(phoneme_dists) if phoneme_dists else None,\n        \"mdd_word_functional\": _dist_stats(func_word),\n        \"mdd_word_lexical\": _dist_stats(lex_word),\n        \"mdd_phoneme_functional\": _dist_stats(func_phon) if func_phon else None,\n        \"mdd_phoneme_lexical\": _dist_stats(lex_phon) if lex_phon else None,\n    }\n\n    # Compute phonological density score\n    max_phoneme = max(PHONOLOGICAL_DATA.values(), key=lambda x: x[\"phoneme_count\"])[\"phoneme_count\"]\n    result[\"phon_density\"] = phono[\"phoneme_count\"] / max_phoneme if max_phoneme > 0 else 0\n\n    logger.info(f\"  Done: {n_sentences} sentences, {len(all_word_arcs)} arcs, MDD={result['mdd_word']['mean']:.3f}\")\n    return result\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Analysis functions \u2500\u2500\u2500\n\ndef run_regression(results: list[dict]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Run regression analysis: MDD ~ phon_density + word_order + family.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        from statsmodels.api import OLS, add_constant\n    except ImportError:\n        # Fallback to manual OLS if statsmodels not available\n        return run_simple_regression(results)\n\n    # Filter valid results\n    valid = [r for r in results if \"mdd_word\" in r and r.get(\"mdd_word\", {}).get(\"mean\", 0) > 0]\n    if len(valid) < 5:\n        return {\"error\": \"too few valid results\", \"n\": len(valid)}\n\n    # Build design matrix\n    mdd_values = np.array([r[\"mdd_word\"][\"mean\"] for r in valid])\n    phon_density = np.array([r.get(\"phon_density\", 0) for r in valid])\n    families = [r.get(\"language_family\", \"Unknown\") for r in valid]\n    word_orders = [r.get(\"word_order\", \"SVO\") for r in valid]\n\n    # Word order encoding (binary: OV vs VO)\n    wo_map = {\"SVO\": 0, \"SOV\": 1, \"VSO\": 1, \"OV\": 1, \"VO\": 0, \"OSV\": 0, \"OVS\": 0, \"VOS\": 0}\n    wo_encoded = np.array([wo_map.get(wo, 0) for wo in word_orders])\n\n    # Design matrix: intercept, phon_density, word_order\n    X = np.column_stack([phon_density, wo_encoded])\n    X = add_constant(X)\n\n    # OLS regression\n    model = OLS(mdd_values, X)\n    try:\n        result = model.fit()\n        # Extract coefficients safely\n        params = result.params\n        pvalues = result.pvalues\n        bse = result.bse\n\n        # Convert to dict with safe handling\n        if hasattr(params, 'keys'):\n            param_dict = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in params.items()}\n            pval_dict = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in pvalues.items()}\n            bse_dict = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in bse.items()}\n        else:\n            param_dict = {f\"coeff_{i}\": float(v) for i, v in enumerate(params)}\n            pval_dict = {f\"pval_{i}\": float(v) for i, v in enumerate(pvalues)}\n            bse_dict = {f\"se_{i}\": float(v) for i, v in enumerate(bse)}\n\n        regression_out = {\n            \"model\": \"OLS\",\n            \"n_languages\": len(valid),\n            \"n_families\": len(set(families)),\n            \"r_squared\": float(result.rsquared),\n            \"r_squared_adj\": float(result.rsquared_adj),\n            \"phon_density_coefficient\": float(param_dict.get('phon_density', param_dict.get('coeff_1', 0))),\n            \"phon_density_p_value\": float(pval_dict.get('phon_density', pval_dict.get('pval_1', 1))),\n            \"phon_density_std_err\": float(bse_dict.get('phon_density', bse_dict.get('se_1', 0))),\n            \"word_order_coefficient\": float(param_dict.get('x1', param_dict.get('coeff_2', 0))),\n            \"word_order_p_value\": float(pval_dict.get('x1', pval_dict.get('pval_2', 1))),\n            \"all_coefficients\": param_dict,\n            \"all_p_values\": pval_dict,\n            \"residual_std\": float(np.std(result.resid)),\n        }\n    except Exception as e:\n        logger.warning(f\"Regression failed: {e}\")\n        regression_out = {\"error\": str(e), \"n_languages\": len(valid)}\n\n    # Spearman correlation (non-parametric robustness check)\n    if len(valid) >= 3:\n        try:\n            spearman_r, spearman_p = stats.spearmanr(phon_density, mdd_values)\n            regression_out[\"spearman_r\"] = float(spearman_r)\n            regression_out[\"spearman_p\"] = float(spearman_p)\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n\n    # Family-level analysis\n    family_means = {}\n    for r in valid:\n        fam = r.get(\"language_family\", \"Unknown\")\n        if fam not in family_means:\n            family_means[fam] = {\"mdd\": [], \"phon_density\": [], \"n\": 1}\n        family_means[fam][\"mdd\"].append(r[\"mdd_word\"][\"mean\"])\n        family_means[fam][\"phon_density\"].append(r.get(\"phon_density\", 0))\n        family_means[fam][\"n\"] += 1\n\n    family_summary = {}\n    for fam, data in family_means.items():\n        family_summary[fam] = {\n            \"n_languages\": data[\"n\"],\n            \"mean_mdd\": float(np.mean(data[\"mdd\"])),\n            \"mean_phon_density\": float(np.mean(data[\"phon_density\"])),\n            \"std_mdd\": float(np.std(data[\"mdd\"])) if len(data[\"mdd\"]) > 1 else 0,\n        }\n    regression_out[\"family_summary\"] = family_summary\n\n    return regression_out\n\n\ndef run_simple_regression(results: list[dict]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Fallback simple regression without statsmodels.\"\"\"\n    valid = [r for r in results if \"mdd_word\" in r and r.get(\"mdd_word\", {}).get(\"mean\", 0) > 0]\n    if len(valid) < 3:\n        return {\"error\": \"too few valid results\", \"n\": len(valid)}\n\n    mdd_values = np.array([r[\"mdd_word\"][\"mean\"] for r in valid])\n    phon_density = np.array([r.get(\"phon_density\", 0) for r in valid])\n\n    # Simple OLS via numpy\n    n = len(mdd_values)\n    x_mean = np.mean(phon_density)\n    y_mean = np.mean(mdd_values)\n\n    ss_xy = np.sum((phon_density - x_mean) * (mdd_values - y_mean))\n    ss_xx = np.sum((phon_density - x_mean) ** 2)\n\n    if ss_xx == 0:\n        return {\"error\": \"zero variance in phon_density\"}\n\n    beta1 = ss_xy / ss_xx\n    beta0 = y_mean - beta1 * x_mean\n\n    # R-squared\n    y_pred = beta0 + beta1 * phon_density\n    ss_res = np.sum((mdd_values - y_pred) ** 2)\n    ss_tot = np.sum((mdd_values - y_mean) ** 2)\n    r_squared = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot if ss_tot > 0 else 0\n\n    regression_out = {\n        \"model\": \"SimpleOLS\",\n        \"n_languages\": n,\n        \"r_squared\": float(r_squared),\n        \"phon_density_coefficient\": float(beta1),\n        \"intercept\": float(beta0),\n    }\n\n    # Spearman correlation\n    try:\n        spearman_r, spearman_p = stats.spearmanr(phon_density, mdd_values)\n        regression_out[\"spearman_r\"] = float(spearman_r)\n        regression_out[\"spearman_p\"] = float(spearman_p)\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n\n    return regression_out\n\n\ndef run_baseline_comparison(results: list[dict]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Baseline: compare word-order groups (SVO vs SOV vs VSO).\"\"\"\n    valid = [r for r in results if \"mdd_word\" in r and r.get(\"mdd_word\", {}).get(\"mean\", 0) > 0]\n\n    groups = defaultdict(list)\n    for r in valid:\n        wo = r.get(\"word_order\", \"Other\")\n        groups[wo].append(r[\"mdd_word\"][\"mean\"])\n\n    comparison = {}\n    for wo, values in groups.items():\n        comparison[wo] = {\n            \"n\": len(values),\n            \"mean\": float(np.mean(values)),\n            \"std\": float(np.std(values)),\n            \"median\": float(np.median(values)),\n        }\n\n    # ANOVA if enough groups\n    if len(groups) >= 2:\n        group_lists = [np.array(v) for v in groups.values()]\n        try:\n            f_stat, p_val = stats.f_oneway(*group_lists)\n            comparison[\"anova_f\"] = float(f_stat)\n            comparison[\"anova_p\"] = float(p_val)\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n\n    # Kruskal-Wallis non-parametric\n    if len(groups) >= 2:\n        try:\n            h_stat, h_p = stats.kruskal(*[np.array(v) for v in groups.values()])\n            comparison[\"kruskal_h\"] = float(h_stat)\n            comparison[\"kruskal_p\"] = float(h_p)\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n\n    return comparison\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Figure generation \u2500\u2500\u2500\n\ndef generate_figures(results: list[dict], out_dir: Path) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Generate publication-quality figures.\"\"\"\n    fig_files = []\n mdd_phoneme = [r.get(\"mdd_phoneme\", {}).get(\"mean\", 0) or 0 for r in valid]\n    families = [r.get(\"language_family\", \"Unknown\") for r in valid]\n    word_orders = [r.get(\"word_order\", \"SVO\") for r in valid]\n\n    # Color by word order\n    wo_colors = {\"SVO\": \"#4C72B0\", \"SOV\": \"#DD8452\", \"VSO\": \"#55A868\",\n                 \"OV\": \"#DD8452\", \"VO\": \"#4C72B0\", "new_content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nPhonological Density and Dependency Distance Minimization.\n\nComputes word-space and phoneme-space dependency distances across UD treebanks,\ncorrelates with phonological density, and tests whether phonologically dense\nlanguages show stronger dependency distance minimization.\n\nBaseline: Word-space MDD only (standard approach in the literature).\nMethod: Phoneme-space MDD + phonological density correlation.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom loguru import logger\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport json\nimport sys\nimport math\nimport resource\nimport gc\nimport time\nfrom typing import Any, Optional\nfrom collections import Counter, defaultdict\nimport matplotlib\nmatplotlib.use('Agg')\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom scipy import stats\nfrom datasets import load_dataset\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Hardware detection (aii-use-hardware) \u2500\u2500\u2500\n\ndef _detect_cpus() -> int:\n    try:\n        parts = Path(\"/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max\").read_text().split()\n        if parts[0] != \"max\":\n            return math.ceil(int(parts[0]) / int(parts[1]))\n    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n        pass\n    try:\n        import os\n        return len(os.sched_getaffinity(0))\n    except (AttributeError, OSError):\n        pass\n    return 2\n\ndef _container_ram_gb() -> float | None:\n    for p in [\"/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max\", \"/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes\"]:\n        try:\n            v = Path(p).read_text().strip()\n            if v != \"max\" and int(v) < 1_000_000_000_000:\n                return int(v) / 1e9\n        except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n            pass\n    return None\n\nNUM_CPUS = _detect_cpus()\nTOTAL_RAM_GB = _container_ram_gb() or 14.0\nAVAILABLE_RAM_GB = TOTAL_RAM_GB * 0.85\nRAM_BUDGET = int(AVAILABLE_RAM_GB * 1e9)\nresource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (RAM_BUDGET * 3, RAM_BUDGET * 3))\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Logging \u2500\u2500\u2500\n\nlogger.remove()\nlogger.add(sys.stdout, level=\"INFO\", format=\"{time:HH:mm:ss}|{level:<7}|{message}\")\nlogger.add(\"logs/run.log\", rotation=\"30 MB\", level=\"DEBUG\")\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Constants \u2500\u2500\u2500\n\nWORKSPACE = list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"Compute word-space dependency distances for a sentence.\"\"\"\n    arcs = []\n    n = len(tokens)\n    for i in range(n):\n        h = heads[i]\n        if h == 0 or h == i + 1: FUNCTIONAL_DEPRELS else \"lexical\"\n        arcs.append({\n            \"head_id\": h,\n            \"dep_id\": i + 1,\n            \"deprel\": deprel,\n            \"category\": category,\n            \"word_dist\": dist,\n        })\n    return arcs\n\n\ndef compute_phoneme_distances(tokens: list[str], heads: list[int], deprels: list[str],\n                               epitran_code: Optional[str] = None) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"Compute phoneme-space dependency distances for a sentence.\"\"\"\n    e = None\n    if epitran_code:\n        try:\n            from epitran import Epitran\n            e = Epitran(epitran_code)\n        except Exception:\n            e = None\n\n    # Build phoneme-position index using char count as fallback for unknown scripts\n    phoneme_positions = []\n    running_idx = 0\n\n    for word in tokens:\n        if e and word.strip():\n            try:\n                phonemes = e.transliterate(word)\n                n_ph = len(phonemes.split())\n            except Exception:\n                n_ph = len(word)\n        else:\n            n_ph = max(len(word), 1)\n        phoneme_positions.append((running_idx, running_idx + n_ph))\n        running_idx += n_ph\n\n    arcs = []\n    n = len(tokens)\n    for i in range(n):\n        h = heads[i]\n        if h == 0 or h == i + 1:\n            continue\n\n        head_start, head_end = phoneme_positions[i]\n        dep_start, dep_end = phoneme_positions[h - 1]\n\n        if i + 1 < h:\n            phoneme_dist = dep_start - head_end\n        else:\n            phoneme_dist = head_start - dep_end\n        phoneme_dist = max(phoneme_dist, 0)\n\n        deprel = deprels[i] if i < len(deprels) else \"unknown\"\n        category = \"functional\" if deprel in FUNCTIONAL_DEPRELS else \"lexical\"\n\n        arcs.append({\n            \"head_id\": h,\n            \"dep_id\": i + 1,\n            \"deprel\": deprel,\n            \"category\": category,\n            \"word_dist\": abs(h - (i + 1)),\n            \"phoneme_dist\": phoneme_dist,\n        })\n    return arcs\n\n\ndef process_treebank(config_name: str, max_sentences: int = 0) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Process a single treebank config and return statistics.\"\"\"\n    import signal\n    \n    lang_code = config_name.split(\"_\")[0]\n    logger.info(f\"Processing {config_name} (lang={lang_code})\")\n\n    # Load dataset with timeout\n    try:\n        def _timeout_handler(signum, frame):\n            raise TimeoutError(f\"Loading {config_name} timed out\")\n        \n        old_handler = signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, _timeout_handler)\n        signal.alarm(60)  # 60 second timeout for loading\n        try:\n            ds = load_dataset(\"commul/universal_dependencies\", name=config_name, split=\"train\")\n        finally:\n            signal.alarm(0)\n            signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, old_handler)\n    except TimeoutError as e:\n        logger.warning(f\"Timed out loading {config_name}, skipping\")\n        return {\"config\": config_name, \"error\": \"timeout loading\", \"timeout\": True}\n    except Exception as e:\n        logger.warning(f\"Failed to load {config_name}: {e}\")\n        return {\"config\": config_name, \"error\": str(e)}\n\n    if len(ds) == 0:\n        return {\"config\": config_name, \"error\": \"empty dataset\"}\n\n    if max_sentences > 0:\n        ds = ds.select(range(min(max_sentences, len(ds))))\n\n    # Get epitran code\n    epitran_code = _get_epitran_code(lang_code)\n\n    all_word_arcs = []\n    all_phoneme_arcs = []\n    n_sentences = 0\n    n_failed = 0\n\n    for idx, row in enumerate(ds):\n        tokens = row[\"tokens\"]\n        heads = row[\"head\"]\n        deprels = row[\"deprel\"]\n\n        if not tokens or not heads:\n            continue\n\n        # Word-space distances\n        try:\n            w_arcs = compute_dependency_distances(tokens, heads, deprels)\n            all_word_arcs.extend(w_arcs)\n        except Exception as e:\n            n_failed += 1\n            continue\n\n        # Phoneme-space distances\n        try:\n            p_arcs = compute_phoneme_distances(tokens, heads, deprels, epitran_code)\n            all_phoneme_arcs.extend(p_arcs)\n        except Exception as e:\n            n_failed += 1\n            continue\n\n        n_sentences += 1\n        if (idx + 1) % 500 == 0:\n            logger.debug(f\"  Processed {idx+1}/{len(ds)} sentences\")\n\n    if not all_word_arcs:\n        return {\"config\": config_name, \"error\": \"no arcs computed\"}\n\n    # Compute statistics\n    word_dists = [a[\"word_dist\"] for a in all_word_arcs]\n    phoneme_dists = [a[\"phoneme_dist\"] for a in all_phoneme_arcs] if all_phoneme_arcs else []\n\n    # Split by category\n    func_word = [a[\"word_dist\"] for a in all_word_arcs if a[\"category\"] == \"functional\"]\n    lex_word = [a[\"word_dist\"] for a in all_word_arcs if a[\"category\"] == \"lexical\"]\n    func_phon = [a[\"phoneme_dist\"] for a in all_phoneme_arcs if a[\"category\"] == \"functional\"] if all_phoneme_arcs else []\n    lex_phon = [a[\"phoneme_dist\"] for a in all_phoneme_arcs if a[\"category\"] == \"lexical\"] if all_phoneme_arcs else []\n\n    # Distributional measures\n    def _dist_stats(dists: list[float]) -> dict:\n        if not dists:\n            return {\"mean\": 0, \"median\": 0, \"std\": 0, \"entropy\": 0, \"p_gt_2\": 0, \"p_gt_5\": 0}\n        arr = np.array(dists)\n        hist, _ = np.histogram(arr, bins=range(1, 21))\n        hist = hist / hist.sum()\n        entropy = -np.sum(hist[hist > 0] * np.log2(hist[hist > 0]))\n        return {\n            \"mean\": float(np.mean(arr)),\n            \"median\": float(np.median(arr)),\n            \"std\": float(np.std(arr)),\n            \"entropy\": float(entropy),\n            \"p_gt_2\": float(np.mean(arr > 2)),\n            \"p_gt_5\": float(np.mean(arr > 5)),\n        }\n\n    # Phonological info\n    phono = get_phono_info(lang_code)\n\n    result = {\n        \"config\": config_name,\n        \"lang_code\": lang_code,\n        \"language_family\": phono[\"family\"],\n        \"branch\": phono[\"branch\"],\n        \"word_order\": phono[\"word_order\"],\n        \"phoneme_count\": phono[\"phoneme_count\"],\n        \"n_sentences\": n_sentences,\n        \"n_arcs\": len(all_word_arcs),\n        \"n_failed\": n_failed,\n        \"epitran_code\": epitran_code,\n        \"has_phoneme_data\": len(phoneme_dists) > 0,\n        \"mdd_word\": _dist_stats(word_dists),\n        \"mdd_phoneme\": _dist_stats(phoneme_dists) if phoneme_dists else None,\n        \"mdd_word_functional\": _dist_stats(func_word),\n        \"mdd_word_lexical\": _dist_stats(lex_word),\n        \"mdd_phoneme_functional\": _dist_stats(func_phon) if func_phon else None,\n        \"mdd_phoneme_lexical\": _dist_stats(lex_phon) if lex_phon else None,\n    }\n\n    # Compute phonological density score\n    max_phoneme = max(PHONOLOGICAL_DATA.values(), key=lambda x: x[\"phoneme_count\"])[\"phoneme_count\"]\n    result[\"phon_density\"] = phono[\"phoneme_count\"] / max_phoneme if max_phoneme > 0 else 0\n\n    logger.info(f\"  Done: {n_sentences} sentences, {len(all_word_arcs)} arcs, MDD={result['mdd_word']['mean']:.3f}\")\n    return result\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Analysis functions \u2500\u2500\u2500\n\ndef run_regression(results: list[dict]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Run regression analysis: MDD ~ phon_density + word_order + family.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        from statsmodels.api import OLS, add_constant\n    except ImportError:\n        # Fallback to manual OLS if statsmodels not available\n        return run_simple_regression(results)\n\n    # Filter valid results\n    valid = [r for r in results if \"mdd_word\" in r and r.get(\"mdd_word\", {}).get(\"mean\", 0) > 0]\n    if len(valid) < 5:\n        return {\"error\": \"too few valid results\", \"n\": len(valid)}\n\n    # Build design matrix\n    mdd_values = np.array([r[\"mdd_word\"][\"mean\"] for r in valid])\n    phon_density = np.array([r.get(\"phon_density\", 0) for r in valid])\n    families = [r.get(\"language_family\", \"Unknown\") for r in valid]\n    word_orders = [r.get(\"word_order\", \"SVO\") for r in valid]\n\n    # Word order encoding (binary: OV vs VO)\n    wo_map = {\"SVO\": 0, \"SOV\": 1, \"VSO\": 1, \"OV\": 1, \"VO\": 0, \"OSV\": 0, \"OVS\": 0, \"VOS\": 0}\n    wo_encoded = np.array([wo_map.get(wo, 0) for wo in word_orders])\n\n    # Design matrix: intercept, phon_density, word_order\n    X = np.column_stack([phon_density, wo_encoded])\n    X = add_constant(X)\n\n    # OLS regression\n    model = OLS(mdd_values, X)\n    try:\n        result = model.fit()\n        # Extract coefficients safely\n        params = result.params\n        pvalues = result.pvalues\n        bse = result.bse\n\n        # Convert to dict with safe handling\n        if hasattr(params, 'keys'):\n            param_dict = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in params.items()}\n            pval_dict = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in pvalues.items()}\n            bse_dict = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in bse.items()}\n        else:\n            param_dict = {f\"coeff_{i}\": float(v) for i, v in enumerate(params)}\n            pval_dict = {f\"pval_{i}\": float(v) for i, v in enumerate(pvalues)}\n            bse_dict = {f\"se_{i}\": float(v) for i, v in enumerate(bse)}\n\n        regression_out = {\n            \"model\": \"OLS\",\n            \"n_languages\": len(valid),\n            \"n_families\": len(set(families)),\n            \"r_squared\": float(result.rsquared),\n            \"r_squared_adj\": float(result.rsquared_adj),\n            \"phon_density_coefficient\": float(param_dict.get('phon_density', param_dict.get('coeff_1', 0))),\n            \"phon_density_p_value\": float(pval_dict.get('phon_density', pval_dict.get('pval_1', 1))),\n            \"phon_density_std_err\": float(bse_dict.get('phon_density', bse_dict.get('se_1', 0))),\n            \"word_order_coefficient\": float(param_dict.get('x1', param_dict.get('coeff_2', 0))),\n            \"word_order_p_value\": float(pval_dict.get('x1', pval_dict.get('pval_2', 1))),\n            \"all_coefficients\": param_dict,\n            \"all_p_values\": pval_dict,\n            \"residual_std\": float(np.std(result.resid)),\n        }\n    except Exception as e:\n        logger.warning(f\"Regression failed: {e}\")\n        regression_out = {\"error\": str(e), \"n_languages\": len(valid)}\n\n    # Spearman correlation (non-parametric robustness check)\n    if len(valid) >= 3:\n        try:\n            spearman_r, spearman_p = stats.spearmanr(phon_density, mdd_values)\n            regression_out[\"spearman_r\"] = float(spearman_r)\n            regression_out[\"spearman_p\"] = float(spearman_p)\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n\n    # Family-level analysis\n    family_means = {}\n    for r in valid:\n        fam = r.get(\"language_family\", \"Unknown\")\n        if fam not in family_means:\n            family_means[fam] = {\"mdd\": [], \"phon_density\": [], \"n\": 1}\n        family_means[fam][\"mdd\"].append(r[\"mdd_word\"][\"mean\"])\n        family_means[fam][\"phon_density\"].append(r.get(\"phon_density\", 0))\n        family_means[fam][\"n\"] += 1\n\n    family_summary = {}\n    for fam, data in family_means.items():\n        family_summary[fam] = {\n            \"n_languages\": data[\"n\"],\n            \"mean_mdd\": float(np.mean(data[\"mdd\"])),\n            \"mean_phon_density\": float(np.mean(data[\"phon_density\"])),\n            \"std_mdd\": float(np.std(data[\"mdd\"])) if len(data[\"mdd\"]) > 1 else 0,\n        }\n    regression_out[\"family_summary\"] = family_summary\n\n    return regression_out\n\n\ndef run_simple_regression(results: list[dict]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Fallback simple regression without statsmodels.\"\"\"\n    valid = [r for r in results if \"mdd_word\" in r and r.get(\"mdd_word\", {}).get(\"mean\", 0) > 0]\n    if len(valid) < 3:\n        return {\"error\": \"too few valid results\", \"n\": len(valid)}\n\n    mdd_values = np.array([r[\"mdd_word\"][\"mean\"] for r in valid])\n    phon_density = np.array([r.get(\"phon_density\", 0) for r in valid])\n\n    # Simple OLS via numpy\n    n = len(mdd_values)\n    x_mean = np.mean(phon_density)\n    y_mean = np.mean(mdd_values)\n\n    ss_xy = np.sum((phon_density - x_mean) * (mdd_values - y_mean))\n    ss_xx = np.sum((phon_density - x_mean) ** 2)\n\n    if ss_xx == 0:\n        return {\"error\": \"zero variance in phon_density\"}\n\n    beta1 = ss_xy / ss_xx\n    beta0 = y_mean - beta1 * x_mean\n\n    # R-squared\n    y_pred = beta0 + beta1 * phon_density\n    ss_res = np.sum((mdd_values - y_pred) ** 2)\n    ss_tot = np.sum((mdd_values - y_mean) ** 2)\n    r_squared = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot if ss_tot > 0 else 0\n\n    regression_out = {\n        \"model\": \"SimpleOLS\",\n        \"n_languages\": n,\n        \"r_squared\": float(r_squared),\n        \"phon_density_coefficient\": float(beta1),\n        \"intercept\": float(beta0),\n    }\n\n    # Spearman correlation\n    try:\n        spearman_r, spearman_p = stats.spearmanr(phon_density, mdd_values)\n        regression_out[\"spearman_r\"] = float(spearman_r)\n        regression_out[\"spearman_p\"] = float(spearman_p)\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n\n    return regression_out\n\n\ndef run_baseline_comparison(results: list[dict]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Baseline: compare word-order groups (SVO vs SOV vs VSO).\"\"\"\n    valid = [r for r in results if \"mdd_word\" in r and r.get(\"mdd_word\", {}).get(\"mean\", 0) > 0]\n\n    groups = defaultdict(list)\n    for r in valid:\n        wo = r.get(\"word_order\", \"Other\")\n        groups[wo].append(r[\"mdd_word\"][\"mean\"])\n\n    comparison = {}\n    for wo, values in groups.items():\n        comparison[wo] = {\n            \"n\": len(values),\n            \"mean\": float(np.mean(values)),\n            \"std\": float(np.std(values)),\n            \"median\": float(np.median(values)),\n        }\n\n    # ANOVA if enough groups\n    if len(groups) >= 2:\n        group_lists = [np.array(v) for v in groups.values()]\n        try:\n            f_stat, p_val = stats.f_oneway(*group_lists)\n            comparison[\"anova_f\"] = float(f_stat)\n            comparison[\"anova_p\"] = float(p_val)\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n\n    # Kruskal-Wallis non-parametric\n    if len(groups) >= 2:\n        try:\n            h_stat, h_p = stats.kruskal(*[np.array(v) for v in groups.values()])\n            comparison[\"kruskal_h\"] = float(h_stat)\n            comparison[\"kruskal_p\"] = float(h_p)\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n\n    return comparison\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Figure generation \u2500\u2500\u2500\n\ndef generate_figures(results: list[dict], out_dir: Path) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Generate publication-quality figures.\"\"\"\n    fig_files = []\n    out_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n\n    valid = [r for r in results if \"mdd_word\" in r and r.get(\"mdd_word\", {}).get(\"mean\", 0) > 0]\n    if len(valid) < 3:\n        logger.warning(\"Too few results for figures\")\n        return fig_files\n\n    # Extract data\n    phon_density = [r.get(\"phon_density\", 0) for r in valid]\n    mdd_word = [r[\"mdd_word\"][\"mean\"] for r in valid]\n    mdd_phoneme = [r.get(\"mdd_phoneme\", {}).get(\"mean\", 0) or 0 for r in valid]\n    families = [r.get(\"language_family\", \"Unknown\") for r in valid]\n    word_orders = [r.get(\"word_order\", \"SVO\") for r in valid]\n\n    # Color by word order\n    wo_colors = {\"SVO\": \"#4C72B0\", \"SOV\": \"#DD8452\", \"VSO\": \"#55A868\",\n                 \"OV\": \"#DD8452\", \"VO\": \"#4C72B0\", \"OSV\": \"#4C72B0\", \"OVS\": \"#55A868\", \"VOS\": \"#55A868\"}\n    colors = [wo_colors.get(wo, \"#888888\") for wo in word_orders]\n\n    # \u2500\u2500 Figure 1: Scatter plot \u2500\u2500\n    try:\n        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4.5))\n        ax.scatter(phon_density, mdd_word, c=colors, s=60, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)\n\n        # Regression line\n        if len(phon_density) > 2:\n            z = np.polyfit(phon_density, mdd_word, 1)\n            p = np.poly1d(z)\n            x_line = np.linspace(min(phon_density), max(phon_density), 100)\n            ax.plot(x_line, p(x_line), \"r--\", alpha=0.8, linewidth=1.5,\n                    label=f\"OLS: \u03b2={z[0]:.3f}\")\n\n        # Color legend\n        from matplotlib.lines import Line2D\n        legend_elements = [Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor=wo_colors[wo],\n                                  markersize=8, label=wo) for wo in sorted(set(word_orders))]\n        ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, title=\"Word Order\", loc=\"lower right\", framealpha=0.9)\n        ax.set_xlabel(\"Phonological Density (normalized phoneme count)\")\n        ax.set_ylabel(\"Mean        fig_path = out_dir / \"fig1_density_vs_mdd.pdf\"\n        fig.savefig(fig_path)\n        plt.close(fig)\n        fig_files.append(str(fig_path))\n        logger.info(f\"Saved {fig_path}\")\n    except Exception as e:\n        logger.warning(f\"Figure 1 failed: {e}\")\n\n    # \u2500\u2500 Figure 2: Word-space vs Phoneme-space MDD \u2500\u2500\n    try:\n        phon_valid = [(pw, pm) for pw, ax.set_ylabel(\"Phoneme-space MDD\")\n            ax.set_title(f\"Word-space vs Phoneme-space Dependency Distance\\n(n={len(pw_list)})\")\n            ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n            fig.tight_layout()\n            fig_path = out_dir / \"fig2_word_vs_phoneme_mdd.pdf\"\n            fig.savefig(fig_path)\n            plt.close(fig)\n            fig_files.append(str(fig_path))\n            logger.info(f\"Saved {fig_path}\")\n    except Exception as e:\n        logger.warning(f\"Figure 2 failed: {e}\")\n\n    # \u2500\u2500 Figure 3: Functional vs Lexical MDD by phonological axes[0].set_xlabel(\"Phonological Density\")\n        axes[0].set_ylabel(\"Functional MDD\")\n        axes[0].set_title(\"Functional Dependencies\")\n        axes[0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n        #     family_names = sorted(family_mdd.keys())\n            family_data = [family_mdd[f] for f in family_names]\n            bp = ax.boxplot(family_data, labels=[f[:12] for f in family_names], import argparse\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--mini\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Run on 3 languages only\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--n-langs\", type=int, default=0, help=\"Run on N languages (0=all)\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    start_time = time.time()\n    logger.info(f\"Starting phonological density + dependency distance analysis\")\n    logger.info(f\"Hardware: {NUM_CPUS} CPUs, {TOTAL_RAM_GB:.1f} GB RAM\")\n\n    # Get all configs with train split (use cache if available)\n    cache_file = WORKSPACE / \"configs_cache.json\"\n    if load_dataset_builder\n        builder = load_dataset_builder(\"commul/universal_dependencies\")\n        configs = builder.BUILDER_CONFIGS\n        train_configs = [c.name for c in configs if \"train\" in c.data_files]\n        cache_file.write_text(json.dumps(train_configs))\n        logger.info(f\"Saved {len(train_configs)} configs to cache\")\n\n    # Select representative configs (one <artifact_plan>
id: gen_plan_experiment_1_idx2
type: experiment
title: Phonological Density and Dependency Distance
summary: >-
  Compute word-space and phoneme-space dependency distances across 40+ UD treebanks, correlate with phonological density,
  and test whether phonologically dense languages show stronger dependency distance minimization. Controls for word order,
  functional vs. lexical split, and corpus choice effects.
runpod_compute_profile: cpu_heavy
implementation_pseudocode: "## PHASE 0: Environment Setup (15 min)\n```\n# Create virtual environment and install dependencies\n\
  uv venv .venv --python=3.12\nuv pip install --python=.venv/bin/python \\\n  datasets conllu loguru pandas numpy scipy scikit-learn\
  \ \\\n  epitran  # grapheme-to-phoneme for 100+ languages\n  # Optional: phonopy for syllable counting\n\n# Verify epitran\
  \ supports target languages:\n# python -c \"from epitran import Epitran; e = Epitran('eng-Latn'); print(e.transliterate('hello'))\"\
  \n```\n\n## PHASE 1: Data Acquisition (30 min)\n```\n# 1.1 Download UD treebanks from HuggingFace\n# Dataset: commul/universal_dependencies\n\
  # Use aii-hf-datasets skill to download\n# Target: 40+ languages across 8+ families\n# Priority families: Indo-European,\
  \ Sino-Tibetan, Austronesian, Turkic, \n#   Uralic, Niger-Congo, Japonic, Koreanic, Semitic, Dravidian\n\n# 1.2 Download\
  \ phonological density data\n# Primary source: Glottolog API (glottolog.org) for phoneme inventory sizes\n# Secondary: PhonHum\
  \ (phonhum.org) for IPA inventories  \n# Fallback: Hard-coded table from PHOIBLE (homburg.linguist.io)\n# Fields needed\
  \ per language: phoneme_count, vowel_count, consonant_count,\n#   syllable_types, max_onset_cluster, max_coda_cluster, language_family\n\
  \n# 1.3 Build language crosswalk\n# Map UD language codes (e.g., 'en', 'zh', 'ar') to Glottolog codes\n# Use UD documentation\
  \ and ISO 639-3 as bridge\n```\n\n## PHASE 2: Dependency Distance Computation (1-2 hours)\n```\n# 2.1 Parse CoNLL-U treebanks\n\
  for each language_treebank:\n    load conllu file\n    for each sentence:\n        extract dependency arcs: (head_id, dep_id,\
  \ deprel, head_form, dep_form)\n        compute word_space_distance = abs(head_id - dep_id)\n        \n        # Split into\
  \ functional vs lexical (Gerdes 2026 taxonomy)\n        if deprel in ['det', 'case', 'aux', 'mark', 'cc', 'punct']:\n  \
  \          category = 'functional'\n        else:\n            category = 'lexical'\n        \n        store: (lang, sent_id,\
  \ head_id, dep_id, deprel, category, word_dist)\n\n# 2.2 Compute phoneme-space distances\n# Use epitran for grapheme-to-phoneme\
  \ conversion\nfor each language:\n    try:\n        epitran_code = map_ud_to_epitran(lang_code)  # e.g., 'en' -> 'eng-Latn'\n\
  \        e = Epitran(epitran_code)\n    except:\n        # Fallback: use character count as proxy (less accurate)\n    \
  \    e = None\n    \n    for each sentence:\n        # Build phoneme-position index: map each word to its phoneme span\n\
  \        phoneme_positions = []  # list of (start_phoneme_idx, end_phoneme_idx)\n        running_phoneme_idx = 0\n     \
  \   \n        for word in sentence_words:\n            if e:\n                phonemes = e.transliterate(word)\n       \
  \         n_phonemes = len(phonemes.split())  # epitran returns space-separated\n            else:\n                n_phonemes\
  \ = len(word)  # character fallback\n            \n            phoneme_positions.append((running_phoneme_idx, running_phoneme_idx\
  \ + n_phonemes))\n            running_phoneme_idx += n_phonemes\n        \n        # Compute phoneme-space dependency distance\n\
  \        for each arc (head_id, dep_id):\n            head_phoneme_start = phoneme_positions[head_id-1][0]\n           \
  \ head_phoneme_end = phoneme_positions[head_id-1][1]\n            dep_phoneme_start = phoneme_positions[dep_id-1][0]\n \
  \           dep_phoneme_end = phoneme_positions[dep_id-1][1]\n            \n            # Distance = minimum phoneme-position\
  \ gap between head and dependent\n            if head_id < dep_id:\n                phoneme_dist = dep_phoneme_start - head_phoneme_end\n\
  \            else:\n                phoneme_dist = head_phoneme_start - dep_phoneme_end\n            \n            store:\
  \ (lang, sent_id, head_id, dep_id, word_dist, phoneme_dist, \n                    head_phonemes, dep_phonemes, category)\n\
  \n# 2.3 Aggregate statistics per language\nfor each language:\n    mdd_word = mean(word_dist)\n    mdd_phoneme = mean(phoneme_dist)\n\
  \    mdd_word_functional = mean(word_dist where category=='functional')\n    mdd_word_lexical = mean(word_dist where category=='lexical')\n\
  \    mdd_phoneme_functional = mean(phoneme_dist where category=='functional')\n    mdd_phoneme_lexical = mean(phoneme_dist\
  \ where category=='lexical')\n    \n    # Distributional measures (Ferrer-i-Cancho 2021)\n    dd_distribution = histogram(word_dist,\
  \ bins=range(1, 21))\n    dd_phoneme_distribution = histogram(phoneme_dist, bins=auto)\n    \n    # Tail behavior: P(distance\
  \ > k) for k in [1, 2, ..., 10]\n    tail_probs = [proportion(word_dist > k) for k in range(1, 11)]\n    \n    # Shannon\
  \ entropy of distance distribution\n    dd_entropy = entropy(dd_distribution)\n```\n\n## PHASE 3: Phonological Density Computation\
  \ (30 min)\n```\n# 3.1 Compute phonological density index per language\nfor each language:\n    # Component 1: Phoneme inventory\
  \ size (normalized)\n    phoneme_density = phoneme_count / max_phoneme_count_across_all_langs\n    \n    # Component 2:\
  \ Phonotactic complexity\n    # Max onset cluster size + max coda cluster size\n    phonotactic_complexity = (max_onset\
  \ + max_coda) / max_possible\n    \n    # Component 3: Syllable type richness\n    syllable_richness = log2(syllable_types)\
  \ / log2(max_syllable_types)\n    \n    # Composite phonological density score (standardized)\n    phon_density = (phoneme_density\
  \ + phonotactic_complexity + syllable_richness) / 3\n    \n    # Also compute individual components for sensitivity analysis\n\
  \    store: (lang, phon_density, phoneme_count, phonotactic_complexity, \n            syllable_richness, language_family,\
  \ word_order)\n```\n\n## PHASE 4: Statistical Analysis (1 hour)\n```\n# 4.1 Primary analysis: Hierarchical linear regression\n\
  # Model: DLM_strength ~ phon_density + word_order + (1 | language_family)\n# Using statsmodels MixedLM or scikit-learn with\
  \ manual family grouping\n\nfrom statsmodels.api import MixedLM\n\n# Response: MDD (lower = stronger minimization)\n# Also\
  \ test: MDD_lexical only, phoneme-space MDD\n\nmodel = MixedLM(\n    endog=mdd_values,\n    exog=design_matrix,  # phon_density,\
  \ word_order_dummies, corpus_size\n    groups=family_codes,\n    re_formula='~1'  # random intercept per family\n)\nresult\
  \ = model.fit()\n\n# Key test: Is phon_density coefficient significant (p < 0.05)?\n# Expected: positive coefficient (higher\
  \ density -> higher MDD = weaker minimization)\n# Wait: hypothesis says \"stronger minimization\" = LOWER MDD\n# So expected:\
  \ negative coefficient (higher density -> lower MDD)\n\n# 4.2 Sensitivity analyses\n# a) Control for syllable count: add\
  \ mean_syllables_per_word as covariate\n# b) Control for morphological complexity: add mean_morphemes_per_word\n# c) Family-level\
  \ cross-validation: leave-one-family-out\n# d) Corpus choice sensitivity (Dobrovoljc 2026): if multiple treebanks per language,\n\
  #    compute within-language variance and use as weight\n\n# 4.3 Secondary analysis: Modality comparison\n# If spoken vs\
  \ written treebanks available (e.g., en-gsd vs en-lines),\n# compare DLM strength across modalities\n# Test: does phon_density\
  \ interact with modality?\n\n# 4.4 Distributional analysis\n# Compare full distance distributions (not just mean)\n# Use\
  \ KS test to compare distance distributions between high vs low density languages\n# Plot: cumulative distribution functions\n\
  ```\n\n## PHASE 5: Visualization and Output (30 min)\n```\n# 5.1 Generate figures\n# Figure 1: Scatter plot of phon_density\
  \ vs MDD with regression line\n# Figure 2: Box plots of MDD by language family, colored by phon_density\n# Figure 3: Cumulative\
  \ distribution functions for high vs low density languages\n# Figure 4: Functional vs lexical split — does effect hold for\
  \ lexical only?\n# Figure 5: Word-space vs phoneme-space MDD correlation\n\n# 5.2 Generate method_out.json\n# Structure:\n\
  {\n  \"languages\": [{\n    \"lang_code\": \"en\",\n    \"language_family\": \"Indo-European\",\n    \"word_order\": \"\
  SVO\",\n    \"phon_density\": 0.65,\n    \"phoneme_count\": 44,\n    \"mdd_word\": 2.1,\n    \"mdd_phoneme\": 5.3,\n   \
  \ \"mdd_word_functional\": 1.2,\n    \"mdd_word_lexical\": 2.5,\n    \"mdd_phoneme_functional\": 3.1,\n    \"mdd_phoneme_lexical\"\
  : 6.2,\n    \"n_sentences\": 1234,\n    \"n_arcs\": 5678,\n    \"corpus_source\": \"gsd\"\n  }],\n  \"regression_results\"\
  : {\n    \"model\": \"MixedLM\",\n    \"phon_density_coefficient\": -0.XX,\n    \"phon_density_p_value\": 0.XX,\n    \"\
  r_squared\": 0.XX,\n    \"n_languages\": 42,\n    \"n_families\": 8\n  },\n  \"sensitivity_results\": {...},\n  \"figures\"\
  : [\"fig1_scatter.pdf\", \"fig2_boxplot.pdf\", ...]\n}\n```\n\n## ERROR HANDLING AND FALLBACKS\n```\n# If epitran fails\
  \ for a language:\n#   -> Use character count as phoneme proxy (document as limitation)\n#   -> Flag language in output\n\
  \n# If Glottolog data unavailable:\n#   -> Use hard-coded phoneme counts from PHOIBLE (curated table)\n#   -> Prioritize\
  \ languages with available data\n\n# If < 30 languages have complete data:\n#   -> Proceed with available languages but\
  \ note limitation\n#   -> Focus on families with >= 3 languages for robust family-level analysis\n\n# If MixedLM convergence\
  \ fails:\n#   -> Fall back to OLS with family fixed effects\n#   -> Or use non-parametric Spearman correlation as robustness\
  \ check\n```\n\n## SUCCESS CRITERIA (for executor to check)\n1. >= 30 languages with complete phonological + dependency\
  \ data\n2. >= 5 language families represented\n3. Regression model converges and produces interpretable coefficients\n4.\
  \ All figures render without errors\n5. method_out.json validates against schema"
fallback_plan: |-
  If the primary approach fails, execute these fallbacks in order:

  **Fallback 1: Simplified phonological proxy (if epitran fails for >50% of languages)**
  - Replace phoneme-count-based distances with character-count-based distances
  - Use character inventory size (from WALS) as proxy for phonological density
  - This loses phonological precision but preserves the experimental design
  - Document as a "character-space" analysis rather than "phoneme-space"

  **Fallback 2: Reduced language set (if Glottolog/PhonHum data unavailable)**
  - Focus on the 20-25 languages with the most complete phonological data
  - Prioritize: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, Russian, Polish, Czech, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Hebrew, Turkish, Finnish, Hungarian, Thai, Vietnamese, Malay, Indonesian, Hindi, Bengali, Swahili
  - This reduces statistical power but maintains cross-family coverage

  **Fallback 3: Correlation-only analysis (if hierarchical modeling fails)**
  - Replace MixedLM with Spearman rank correlation between phon_density and MDD
  - Add partial correlation controlling for word order
  - Use family-level means (one point per family) to avoid pseudoreplication
  - Less powerful but more robust to distributional assumptions

  **Fallback 4: Word-space only (if phoneme-space computation proves infeasible)**
  - Drop the phoneme-position distance metric entirely
  - Test whether phonological density predicts WORD-SPACE MDD strength
  - This tests a weaker version of the hypothesis (phonological pressure affects word-level optimization) but is still novel
  - The key finding would be: "Languages with denser phonologies show stronger word-level dependency minimization"

  **Fallback 5: Single-metric density (if composite index fails)**
  - Use raw phoneme inventory size as the sole density metric
  - Simpler but less theoretically grounded
  - Still tests the core prediction

  **Fallback 6: Qualitative case studies (if quantitative analysis fails entirely)**
  - Select 4-6 language pairs (high vs low density within same family)
  - Compare their dependency distance distributions qualitatively
  - Present as exploratory analysis with clear limitations
testing_plan: |-
  ## Testing Strategy: Mini -> Small -> Full Scale

  ### Step 1: Unit Tests (5 min, before any data loading)
  ```
  # Test epitran works for key languages
  python -c "
  from epitran import Epitran
  for code in ['eng-Latn', 'deu-Latn', 'jpn-Jpan', 'zho-Hans', 'ara-Arab']:
      e = Epitran(code)
      print(f'{code}: {e.transliterate(\"hello\")}')
  "

  # Test conllu parsing
  python -c "
  import conllu
  # Parse a sample sentence
  sentence = conllu.parse('1\tThe\tthe\tDET\t_\t_\t2\tdet\t_\t_\n2\tcat\tcat\tNOUN\t_\t_\t0\troot\t_\t_\n')
  print(f'Parsed {len(sentence)} sentences')
  "
  ```

  ### Step 2: Mini Run (15 min, 3 languages)
  ```
  # Run full pipeline on 3 languages: English, Japanese, Arabic
  # These represent: low density (English), high density (Japanese), medium density (Arabic)
  # Verify:
  #   - Data loads correctly from HuggingFace
  #   - Dependency distances computed correctly (manual check on 1 sentence)
  #   - Phoneme conversion works
  #   - Phonological density values loaded
  #   - Regression runs without error
  #   - Output JSON has correct structure

  # Expected output: method_out_mini.json with 3 language entries
  # Check: MDD values are in reasonable range (1.5-4.0 for word-space)
  # Check: Phoneme distances > word distances (as expected)
  ```

  ### Step 3: Small Run (30 min, 10 languages)
  ```
  # Expand to 10 languages across 5 families
  # Verify:
  #   - Cross-family variation is visible
  #   - Regression coefficients are reasonable (not NaN, not extreme)
  #   - Figures render correctly
  #   - Runtime per language is manageable (< 30 seconds)

  # Estimate total runtime: 10 langs * 30s = 5 min + analysis = 10 min
  # If runtime > 1 min per language, optimize (vectorize, cache epitran)
  ```

  ### Step 4: Full Run (2-3 hours, 40+ languages)
  ```
  # Scale to full dataset
  # Monitor:
  #   - Memory usage (should be < 4GB for UD treebanks)
  #   - Runtime per language
  #   - Error rate (languages that fail)
  #   - Data quality (are MDD values in expected range?)

  # Use aii-long-running-tasks pattern:
  #   - Run in background with timeout
  #   - Log progress every 5 languages
  #   - Save intermediate results after each language
  #   - If total time > 4 hours, stop and report partial results
  ```

  ### Step 5: Validation Checks
  ```
  # 5.1 Reproduce known results
  #   - English MDD should be ~2.1-2.3 (Futrell et al. 2015)
  #   - Japanese MDD should be ~2.5-2.8 (OV language, slightly higher)
  #   - If values are way off, check parsing logic

  # 5.2 Sanity checks
  #   - Functional dependencies should have lower MDD than lexical (Gerdes 2026)
  #   - Phoneme-space distances should be > word-space distances
  #   - OV languages should have different patterns than SVO (Liu 2008)

  # 5.3 Dobrovoljc (2026) check
  #   - If multiple treebanks per language, verify MDD varies across corpora
  #   - This confirms we're capturing the corpus-choice sensitivity she documented

  # 5.4 Statistical checks
  #   - Check regression residuals for normality
  #   - Check for outliers (languages with extreme MDD)
  #   - Verify family-level random effects are meaningful
  ```

  ### Go/No-Go Decision Points
  - **After Step 2**: If epitran fails for all 3 languages -> switch to character fallback immediately
  - **After Step 3**: If regression produces NaN or convergence errors -> switch to correlation-only
  - **After Step 4**: If < 20 languages have complete data -> proceed with available data, document limitation
  - **At any point**: If total runtime exceeds 4 hours -> save partial results and stop
</artifact_plan>

mapping.get(lang_code)\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Core computation functions \u2500\u2500\u2500\n\ndef compute_dependency_distances(tokens: list[str], heads: list[int], deprels: list[str]) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"Compute word-space dependency distances for a sentence.\"\"\"\n    arcs = []\n    n = len(tokens)\n    for i in range(n):\n        h = heads[i]\n        if h == 0 or h == i + 1:  # root or self-loop\n            continue\n        dist = abs(h - (i + 1))\n        deprel = deprels[i] if i < len(deprels) else \"unknown\"\n        category = \"functional\" if deprel in FUNCTIONAL_DEPRELS else \"lexical\"\n        arcs.append({\n            \"head_id\": h,\n            \"dep_id\": i + 1,\n            \"deprel\": deprel,\n            \"category\": category,\n            \"word_dist\": dist,\n        })\n    return arcs\n\n\ndef compute_phoneme_distances(tokens: list[str], heads: list[int], deprels: list[str],\n                               epitran_code: Optional[str] = None) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"Compute phoneme-space dependency distances for a sentence.\"\"\"\n    e = None\n    if epitran_code:\n        try:\n            from epitran import Epitran\n            e = Epitran(epitran_code)\n        except Exception:\n            e = None\n\n    # Build phoneme-position index using char count as fallback for unknown scripts\n    phoneme_positions = []\n    running_idx = 0\n\n    for word in tokens:\n        if e and word.strip():\n            try:\n                phonemes = e.transliterate(word)\n                n_ph = len(phonemes.split())\n            except Exception:\n                n_ph = len(word)\n        else:\n            n_ph = max(len(word), 1)\n        phoneme_positions.append((running_idx, running_idx + n_ph))\n        running_idx += n_ph\n\n    arcs = []\n    n = len(tokens)\n    for i in range(n):\n        h = heads[i]\n        if h == 0 or h == i + 1:\n            continue\n\n        head_start, head_end = phoneme_positions[i]\n        dep_start, dep_end = phoneme_positions[h - 1]\n\n        if i + 1 < h:\n            phoneme_dist = dep_start - head_end\n        else:\n            phoneme_dist = head_start - dep_end\n        phoneme_dist = max(phoneme_dist, 0)\n\n        deprel = deprels[i] if i < len(deprels) else \"unknown\"\n        category = \"functional\" if deprel in FUNCTIONAL_DEPRELS else \"lexical\"\n\n        arcs.append({\n            \"head_id\": h,\n            \"dep_id\": i + 1,\n            \"deprel\": deprel,\n            \"category\": category,\n            \"word_dist\": abs(h - (i + 1)),\n            \"phoneme_dist\": phoneme_dist,\n        })\n    return arcs\n\n\ndef process_treebank(config_name: str, max_sentences: int = 0) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Process a single treebank config and return statistics.\"\"\"\n    import signal\n    \n    lang_code = config_name.split(\"_\")[0]\n    logger.info(f\"Processing {config_name} (lang={lang_code})\")\n\n    # Load dataset with timeout\n    try:\n        def _timeout_handler(signum, frame):\n            raise TimeoutError(f\"Loading {config_name} timed out\")\n        \n        old_handler = signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, _timeout_handler)\n        signal.alarm(60)  # 60 second timeout for loading\n        try:\n            ds = load_dataset(\"commul/universal_dependencies\", name=config_name, split=\"train\")\n        finally:\n            signal.alarm(0)\n            signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, old_handler)\n    except TimeoutError as e:\n        logger.warning(f\"Timed out loading {config_name}, skipping\")\n        return {\"config\": config_name, \"error\": \"timeout loading\", \"timeout\": True}\n    except Exception as e:\n        logger.warning(f\"Failed to load {config_name}: {e}\")\n        return {\"config\": config_name, \"error\": str(e)}\n\n    if len(ds) == 0:\n        return {\"config\": config_name, \"error\": \"empty dataset\"}\n\n    if max_sentences > 0:\n        ds = ds.select(range(min(max_sentences, len(ds))))\n\n    # Get epitran code\n    epitran_code = _get_epitran_code(lang_code)\n\n    all_word_arcs = []\n    all_phoneme_arcs = []\n    n_sentences = 0\n    n_failed = 0\n\n    for idx, row in enumerate(ds):\n        tokens = row[\"tokens\"]\n        heads = row[\"head\"]\n        deprels = row[\"deprel\"]\n\n        if not tokens or not heads:\n            continue\n\n        # Word-space distances\n        try:\n            w_arcs = compute_dependency_distances(tokens, heads, deprels)\n            all_word_arcs.extend(w_arcs)\n        except Exception as e:\n            n_failed += 1\n            continue\n\n        # Phoneme-space distances\n        try:\n            p_arcs = compute_phoneme_distances(tokens, heads, deprels, epitran_code)\n            all_phoneme_arcs.extend(p_arcs)\n        except Exception as e:\n            n_failed += 1\n            continue\n\n        n_sentences += 1\n        if (idx + 1) % 500 == 0:\n            logger.debug(f\"  Processed {idx+1}/{len(ds)} sentences\")\n\n    if not all_word_arcs:\n        return {\"config\": config_name, \"error\": \"no arcs computed\"}\n\n    # Compute statistics\n    word_dists = [a[\"word_dist\"] for a in all_word_arcs]\n    phoneme_dists = [a[\"phoneme_dist\"] for a in all_phoneme_arcs] if all_phoneme_arcs else []\n\n    # Split by category\n    func_word = [a[\"word_dist\"] for a in all_word_arcs if a[\"category\"] == \"functional\"]\n    lex_word = [a[\"word_dist\"] for a in all_word_arcs if a[\"category\"] == \"lexical\"]\n    func_phon = [a[\"phoneme_dist\"] for a in all_phoneme_arcs if a[\"category\"] == \"functional\"] if all_phoneme_arcs else []\n    lex_phon = [a[\"phoneme_dist\"] for a in all_phoneme_arcs if a[\"category\"] == \"lexical\"] if all_phoneme_arcs else []\n\n    # Distributional measures\n    def _dist_stats(dists: list[float]) -> dict:\n        if not dists:\n            return {\"mean\": 0, \"median\": 0, \"std\": 0, \"entropy\": 0, \"p_gt_2\": 0, \"p_gt_5\": 0}\n        arr = np.array(dists)\n        hist, _ = np.histogram(arr, bins=range(1, 21))\n        hist = hist / hist.sum()\n        entropy = -np.sum(hist[hist > 0] * np.log2(hist[hist > 0]))\n        return {\n            \"mean\": float(np.mean(arr)),\n            \"median\": float(np.median(arr)),\n            \"std\": float(np.std(arr)),\n            \"entropy\": float(entropy),\n            \"p_gt_2\": float(np.mean(arr > 2)),\n            \"p_gt_5\": float(np.mean(arr > 5)),\n        }\n\n    # Phonological info\n    phono = get_phono_info(lang_code)\n\n    result = {\n        \"config\": config_name,\n        \"lang_code\": lang_code,\n        \"language_family\": phono[\"family\"],\n        \"branch\": phono[\"branch\"],\n        \"word_order\": phono[\"word_order\"],\n        \"phoneme_count\": phono[\"phoneme_count\"],\n        \"n_sentences\": n_sentences,\n        \"n_arcs\": len(all_word_arcs),\n        \"n_failed\": n_failed,\n        \"epitran_code\": epitran_code,\n        \"has_phoneme_data\": len(phoneme_dists) > 0,\n        \"mdd_word\": _dist_stats(word_dists),\n        \"mdd_phoneme\": _dist_stats(phoneme_dists) if phoneme_dists else None,\n        \"mdd_word_functional\": _dist_stats(func_word),\n        \"mdd_word_lexical\": _dist_stats(lex_word),\n        \"mdd_phoneme_functional\": _dist_stats(func_phon) if func_phon else None,\n        \"mdd_phoneme_lexical\": _dist_stats(lex_phon) if lex_phon else None,\n    }\n\n    # Compute phonological density score\n    max_phoneme = max(PHONOLOGICAL_DATA.values(), key=lambda x: x[\"phoneme_count\"])[\"phoneme_count\"]\n    result[\"phon_density\"] = phono[\"phoneme_count\"] / max_phoneme if max_phoneme > 0 else 0\n\n    logger.info(f\"  Done: {n_sentences} sentences, {len(all_word_arcs)} arcs, MDD={result['mdd_word']['mean']:.3f}\")\n    return result\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Analysis functions \u2500\u2500\u2500\n\ndef run_regression(results: list[dict]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Run regression analysis: MDD ~ phon_density + word_order + family.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        from statsmodels.api import OLS, add_constant\n    except ImportError:\n        # Fallback to manual OLS if statsmodels not available\n        return run_simple_regression(results)\n\n    # Filter valid results\n    valid = [r for r in results if \"mdd_word\" in r and r.get(\"mdd_word\", {}).get(\"mean\", 0) > 0]\n    if len(valid) < 5:\n        return {\"error\": \"too few valid results\", \"n\": len(valid)}\n\n    # Build design matrix\n    mdd_values = np.array([r[\"mdd_word\"][\"mean\"] for r in valid])\n    phon_density = np.array([r.get(\"phon_density\", 0) for r in valid])\n    families = [r.get(\"language_family\", \"Unknown\") for r in valid]\n    word_orders = [r.get(\"word_order\", \"SVO\") for r in valid]\n\n    # Word order encoding (binary: OV vs VO)\n    wo_map = {\"SVO\": 0, \"SOV\": 1, \"VSO\": 1, \"OV\": 1, \"VO\": 0, \"OSV\": 0, \"OVS\": 0, \"VOS\": 0}\n    wo_encoded = np.array([wo_map.get(wo, 0) for wo in word_orders])\n\n    # Design matrix: intercept, phon_density, word_order\n    X = np.column_stack([phon_density, wo_encoded])\n    X = add_constant(X)\n\n    # OLS regression\n    model = OLS(mdd_values, X)\n    try:\n        result = model.fit()\n        # Extract coefficients safely\n        params = result.params\n        pvalues = result.pvalues\n        bse = result.bse\n\n        # Convert to dict with safe handling\n        if hasattr(params, 'keys'):\n            param_dict = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in params.items()}\n            pval_dict = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in pvalues.items()}\n            bse_dict = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in bse.items()}\n \"phon_density_std_err\": float(bse_dict.get('phon_density', bse_dict.get('se_1', 0))),\n            \"word_order_coefficient\": float(param_dict.get('x1', param_dict.get('coeff_2', 0))),\n     }\n    regression_out[\"family_summary\"] = family_summary\n\n    return regression_out\n\n\ndef run_simple_regression(results: list[dict]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Fallback simple regression without statsmodels.\"\"\"\n    valid = [r for r in results if \"mdd_word\" in r and r.get(\"mdd_word\", {}).get(\"mean\", 0) > 0]\n    if len(valid) < 3:\n        return {\"error\": \"too few valid results\", \"n\": len(valid)}\n\n    mdd_values = np.array([r[\"mdd_word\"][\"mean\"] for r in valid])\n    phon_density = np.array([r.get(\"phon_density\", 0) for r in valid])\n\n    # Simple OLS via numpy\n    n = len(mdd_values)\n    x_mean = np.mean(phon_density)\n    y_mean = np.mean(mdd_values)\n\n    ss_xy = np.sum((phon_density - x_mean) * (mdd_values - y_mean))\n    ss_xx = np.sum((phon_density - x_mean) ** 2)\n\n    if ss_xx == 0:\n        return {\"error\": \"zero variance in phon_density\"}\n\n    beta1 = ss_xy / ss_xx\n    beta0 = y_mean - beta1 * x_mean\n\n    # 0 else 0\n\n    regression_out = {\n        \"model\": \"SimpleOLS\",\n        \"n_languages\": n,\n        \"r_squared\": float(r_squared),\n        \"phon_density_coefficient\": float(beta1),\n groups = defaultdict(list)\n    for r in valid:\n        wo = r.get(\"word_order\", \"Other\")\n        groups[wo].append(r[\"mdd_word\"][\"mean\"])\n\n    comparison = {}\n    for wo, values in "new_content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nPhonological Density and Dependency Distance Minimization.\n\nComputes word-space and phoneme-space dependency distances across UD treebanks,\ncorrelates with phonological density, and tests whether phonologically dense\nlanguages show stronger dependency distance minimization.\n\nBaseline: Word-space MDD only (standard approach in the literature).\nMethod: Phoneme-space MDD + phonological density correlation.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom loguru import logger\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport json\nimport sys\nimport math\nimport resource\nimport gc\nimport time\nfrom typing import Any, Optional\nfrom collections import Counter, defaultdict\nimport matplotlib\nmatplotlib.use('Agg')\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom scipy import stats\nfrom datasets import load_dataset\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Hardware detection (aii-use-hardware) \u2500\u2500\u2500\n\ndef _detect_cpus() -> int:\n    try:\n        parts = Path(\"/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max\").read_text().split()\n        if parts[0] != \"max\":\n            return math.ceil(int(parts[0]) / int(parts[1]))\n    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n        pass\n    try:\n        import os\n        return len(os.sched_getaffinity(0))\n    except (AttributeError, OSError):\n        pass\n    return 2\n\ndef _container_ram_gb() -> float | None:\n    for p in [\"/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max\", \"/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes\"]:\n        try:\n            v = Path(p).read_text().strip()\n            if v != \"max\" and int(v) < 1_000_000_000_000:\n                return int(v) / 1e9\n        except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n            pass\n    return None\n\nNUM_CPUS = _detect_cpus()\nTOTAL_RAM_GB = _container_ram_gb() or 14.0\nAVAILABLE_RAM_GB = TOTAL_RAM_GB * 0.85\nRAM_BUDGET = int(AVAILABLE_RAM_GB * 1e9)\nresource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (RAM_BUDGET * 3, RAM_BUDGET * 3))\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Logging \u2500\u2500\u2500\n\nlogger.remove()\nlogger.add(sys.stdout, level=\"INFO\", format=\"{time:HH:mm:ss}|{level:<7}|{message}\")\nlogger.add(\"logs/run.log\", rotation=\"30 MB\", level=\"DEBUG\")\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Constants \u2500\u2500\u2500\n\nWORKSPACE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent\nLOGS_DIR = WORKSPACE / \"logs\"\nLOGS_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n\nFUNCTIONAL_DEPRELS = {\n    \"det\", \"case\", \"aux\", \"mark\", \"cc\", \"punct\",\n
